page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, providing 32 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark data positions this instance primarily in the average tier for most compute and memory operations, with a few notable exceptions. The Passmark memory score is strong, placing in the top 25% of tested instances, which aligns with its high-speed memory architecture. In LLM inference testing using a small 135M model, the instance achieved a strong text generation speed of 304.16 tokens per second, though prompt processing for the same model and all tests on the medium 7B model fell into the average category. Other benchmarks, including Geekbench multi-core and Passmark CPU, reflect standard mid-range performance for a 32-core configuration.

The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which may impact I/O-heavy workloads. However, the dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention. The instance is configured for general-purpose workloads, including static web serving, software compilation, database operations, and moderate-scale text or image processing.
